items.b: ICBC SETS GOLD MARGIN AT 190%, FORCED-SALE LINE AT 170%
items.t: More than 10 Chinese banks have shut or tightened personal access to Shanghai Gold Exchange metals trading this year. The count stood at 6 on 9 September; Pudong Development closes its channel on 25 September.

items.b: 300KG OF GOLD CLEARS SANYA AIRPORT FROM SINGAPORE
items.t: The consignment transited Guangzhou and moved into the Shanghai Gold Exchange's Sanya warehouse. Customs ran advance declaration, air-to-air transit and apron collection as one procedure, which Sanya Daily reports as a first at the port.

items.b: DGFT DROPS THE RCMC REQUIREMENT ON EXPORTS UNDER ₹3 LAKH
items.t: Notification 36/2026-27 amends paragraph 2.57 of the Foreign Trade Policy 2023, effective 15 September. Consignments up to USD 3,000 were 43% of India's shipping bills and 0.86% of export value from 2021-22 to 2025-26.

items.b: INDIA'S POLISHED EXPORTS FALL 4.93% IN VALUE, RISE 3.23% IN CARATS
items.t: Total gem and jewellery exports reached $2.30 billion in August, up 3.14% year on year on the council's figures. Studded gold jewellery added 51.22% to $642.85 million.

items.b: DGCX HANDS ITS TRADING AND CLEARING ENGINE TO TCS
items.t: Tata Consultancy Services will supply BaNCS for central counterparty clearing and trading, and Quartz for surveillance and connectivity. TCS shares rose 5.19% to ₹2,315 in intraday trade on 15 September.
